name: REA 50 Companion Skills for Claude Code
type: community-authored companion skills; not an official morluto/rea distribution

skills.name: rea-task-triage
skills.title: REA Task Triage
skills.description: Use this skill when a reverse-engineering request arrives and the target type, evidence source, or safest REA workflow needs to be selected. It routes the task to available REA capabilities without running unrelated diagnostics.

skills.name: rea-js-app-map
skills.title: JavaScript Application Map
skills.description: Use when the user needs an architectural map of an extracted JavaScript or Electron app: modules, imports, package boundaries, entry points, and relationships.

skills.name: rea-js-export-shapes
skills.title: JavaScript Export Shape Diff
skills.description: Use when comparing the returned object/API shape of one named JavaScript export across two application versions.

skills.name: rea-js-module-graph
skills.title: JavaScript Dependency Graph
skills.description: Use for tracing direct and transitive module dependencies, cycles, and likely change-impact areas in a supplied JavaScript/Electron artifact.

skills.name: rea-electron-ipc
skills.title: Electron IPC Boundary Tracing
skills.description: Use when investigating how an Electron renderer feature crosses preload, IPC, and main-process boundaries.

skills.name: rea-electron-native-addons
skills.title: Electron Native Add-on Inventory
skills.description: Use when mapping Electron/Node native modules and their relationships to JavaScript code.

skills.name: rea-app-version-diff
skills.title: Application Version Comparison
skills.description: Use when comparing two shipped JavaScript/Electron application versions for structural or semantic module changes.

skills.name: rea-feature-trace
skills.title: Application Feature Trace
skills.description: Use when asked how a named feature in a shipped JavaScript/Electron app works, from UI/API entry to underlying implementation.

skills.name: rea-source-map-provenance
skills.title: Source Map and Bundle Provenance
skills.description: Use when reconstructing source-file relationships from JavaScript bundles and source maps.

skills.name: rea-js-bundle-reconstruction
skills.title: JavaScript Bundle Reconstruction Plan
skills.description: Use when a user wants a maintainable, original implementation based on observed behavior and static bundle evidence.

skills.name: rea-native-binary-triage
skills.title: Native Binary Triage
skills.description: Use when starting analysis of an authorized native executable, library, or analysis database.

skills.name: rea-native-function-analysis
skills.title: Native Function Investigation
skills.description: Use when analyzing a single native function with pseudocode, assembly, references, or neighboring functions.

skills.name: rea-native-xref-tracing
skills.title: Native Cross-Reference Tracing
skills.description: Use for tracing incoming/outgoing references to a native function, string, global, or address.

skills.name: rea-native-call-graph
skills.title: Native Call Graph Analysis
skills.description: Use when the user needs a bounded call graph around a specific native routine.

skills.name: rea-native-string-analysis
skills.title: Native String Reference Analysis
skills.description: Use when investigating a feature by tracing meaningful strings and their native references.

skills.name: rea-native-function-reconstruction
skills.title: Native Function Reconstruction Spec
skills.description: Use when reconstructing a small native function’s behavior in clean-room source code.

skills.name: rea-assembly-pseudocode-check
skills.title: Assembly vs Pseudocode Verification
skills.description: Use when a decompiler’s pseudocode looks suspicious or must be validated against machine instructions.

skills.name: rea-native-abi-analysis
skills.title: Native ABI and Calling Convention Analysis
skills.description: Use when determining how a native function receives arguments, returns values, or crosses module boundaries.

skills.name: rea-crash-core-analysis
skills.title: Recorded Crash/Core Analysis
skills.description: Use when analyzing a supplied crash dump/core file or preserved register snapshot.

skills.name: rea-elf-layout-audit
skills.title: ELF Layout and Mitigation Inventory
skills.description: Use for offline inspection of a supplied Linux ELF’s sections, segments, relocations, and static mitigation indicators.

skills.name: rea-pe-resource-analysis
skills.title: PE Resource Analysis
skills.description: Use when inspecting a supplied Windows PE’s resource tree, icons, manifests, or embedded payloads.

skills.name: rea-windows-binary-inspection
skills.title: Windows Binary Inspection
skills.description: Use for static triage of a supplied Windows executable/library when running it is unnecessary or inappropriate.

skills.name: rea-dos-ghidra-analysis
skills.title: 16-bit DOS Binary Analysis
skills.description: Use when inspecting a legitimate 16-bit DOS/legacy binary through a supported Ghidra workflow.

skills.name: rea-ida-provider-workflow
skills.title: REA with IDA Provider
skills.description: Use when REA’s configured IDA provider is the selected route for a supplied native binary.

skills.name: rea-ghidra-provider-workflow
skills.title: REA with Ghidra Provider
skills.description: Use when REA’s Ghidra provider is the route for native analysis.

skills.name: rea-large-binary-investigation
skills.title: Large Binary Investigation
skills.description: Use when the binary or evidence payload is large enough to risk truncated tool results or excessive context use.

skills.name: rea-rust-binary-inventory
skills.title: Rust Binary Dependency Inventory
skills.description: Use when checking an authorized ELF/PE/thin Mach-O for embedded cargo-auditable Rust dependency metadata.

skills.name: rea-rust-dependency-audit
skills.title: Rust Binary Dependency Audit
skills.description: Use when preparing a dependency/supply-chain review from metadata embedded in a supplied Rust binary.

skills.name: rea-rust-dependency-graph
skills.title: Rust Crate Dependency Graph
skills.description: Use when reconstructing the embedded crate dependency edges in a Rust binary.

skills.name: rea-rust-runtime-boundary
skills.title: Rust Runtime and FFI Boundary Mapping
skills.description: Use when mapping observable Rust-native interfaces, C ABI edges, imports/exports, and dependency boundaries in a compiled artifact.

skills.name: rea-rust-artifact-source-compare
skills.title: Rust Artifact vs Source Comparison
skills.description: Use when checking whether a supplied Rust binary’s embedded metadata and symbols align with a supplied source tree or Cargo.lock.

skills.name: rea-engine-architecture-learning
skills.title: Engine Architecture Learning from Artifacts
skills.description: Use when learning how a game engine or complex native app is structured so the user can design an independent implementation, including in Rust.

skills.name: rea-browser-passive-observation
skills.title: Passive Browser Observation
skills.description: Use when inspecting an already-open, user-owned or authorized website/browser page without performing interactions.

skills.name: rea-browser-scenario-capture
skills.title: Declared Browser Scenario Capture
skills.description: Use when the user explicitly asks to reproduce a specific browser flow on a target they own or are authorized to test.

skills.name: rea-web-feature-tracing
skills.title: Web Feature Trace
skills.description: Use when explaining how a web feature connects DOM/UI code, handlers, API requests, and response rendering.

skills.name: rea-har-network-analysis
skills.title: HAR Network Capture Analysis
skills.description: Use when analyzing a saved HAR file to understand historical web requests/responses without contacting the recorded URLs.

skills.name: rea-saz-traffic-analysis
skills.title: Fiddler SAZ Traffic Analysis
skills.description: Use when inspecting a saved Fiddler Everywhere `.saz` file, or a separately connected live Fiddler MCP session when explicitly requested.

skills.name: rea-pcap-summary-analysis
skills.title: PCAP Summary and Endpoint Analysis
skills.description: Use when summarizing a supplied PCAP’s endpoints, DNS/TLS SNI, protocols, or recorded HTTP requests.

skills.name: rea-packet-field-discovery
skills.title: Packet Field Discovery and Decode
skills.description: Use when finding valid field names/types and choosing decode-as or display filters for an existing packet capture.

skills.name: rea-browser-capture-compare
skills.title: Browser Capture Comparison
skills.description: Use when comparing two browser snapshots or declared scenarios to spot DOM, request, or behavior differences.

skills.name: rea-wasm-module-analysis
skills.title: WebAssembly Artifact Inspection
skills.description: Use when examining a local WASM artifact’s sections, imports/exports, and decoded WAT.

skills.name: rea-evm-bytecode-inspection
skills.title: EVM Bytecode Interface Inspection
skills.description: Use when inspecting caller-supplied EVM bytecode locally to infer selectors, candidate arguments, and mutability.

skills.name: rea-wasm-js-boundary
skills.title: WASM-to-JavaScript Boundary Mapping
skills.description: Use when mapping how JavaScript glue passes data to and receives results from a WASM module.

skills.name: rea-android-apk-triage
skills.title: Android APK Triage
skills.description: Use when inventorying an authorized APK’s identity, manifest declarations, classes, and analysis prerequisites without launching the app.

skills.name: rea-android-method-analysis
skills.title: Android Class and Method Analysis
skills.description: Use when finding a specific Android class/method and its incoming static references in an APK.

skills.name: rea-android-resource-analysis
skills.title: Android Manifest and Resource Analysis
skills.description: Use when inspecting Android manifest entries, string resources, locales, or version facts from a supplied APK.

skills.name: rea-flutter-apk-inventory
skills.title: Flutter APK Static Inventory
skills.description: Use when inventorying supplied Flutter APKs and identifying Dart snapshot/engine build provenance without running the app.

skills.name: rea-dotnet-assembly-analysis
skills.title: .NET Assembly Analysis
skills.description: Use when inspecting a supplied managed .NET assembly’s metadata, CIL, and declared native dependencies.

skills.name: rea-firmware-analysis
skills.title: Firmware Region and Extraction Analysis
skills.description: Use when inspecting a firmware image’s regions and, if explicitly requested, extracting files to a caller-selected directory.

skills.name: rea-sqlite-schema-analysis
skills.title: SQLite Schema and Snapshot Analysis
skills.description: Use when inspecting a supplied SQLite database snapshot’s schema, indexes, triggers, or selected table rows.
